name: Godfrey
summary: The complete ground-ops hub: hangars, cranes, pads, offices, maintenance. Any flat surface in its range is a launch site.
description: DX-91 Godfrey is the Earth facilities hub — hangars, cranes, pads, offices, and maintenance in one complex. Combined with the fleet’s glide-return orbiters and transportable crane, it means no fixed launch complex is needed: any flat surface in range of the hub is a launch site. Roster-level entry only.
